headline: Medtronic (MDT) Stock May Be Fairly Valued As Shares Sit Near A 5 Year Low
summary: Medtronic stock is coming off a 5 year period where the share price has fallen about 25%, yet current checks suggest the shares sit close to their intrinsic value on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) basis and screen as undervalued on earnings multiples. That mix, alongside fresh moves in AI assisted surgery and pain management, leaves investors weighing whether the current price around US$84.22 offers enough compensation for the risks.
